args.message:
Fix round_money to use banker's rounding (ROUND_HALF_EVEN) per FIN-212

The implementation used ROUND_HALF_UP while the contract (docstring,
FIN-212) and tests/test_money.py require ROUND_HALF_EVEN. This caused
the nightly build to fail.

args.body:
## Summary
`round_money` in `src/money.py` used `ROUND_HALF_UP`, but the contract (docstring and FIN-212) requires banker's rounding (`ROUND_HALF_EVEN`). This caused the nightly build to fail (`tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`).

## Change
- Use `ROUND_HALF_EVEN` in `round_money` so half-values round to the nearest even cent (e.g. 2.665 -> 2.66, 2.675 -> 2.68).

## Testing
- CI run `ci-0001` on commit `08d3cd5986`: passed, including `tests/test_money.py::test_half_even`.
